apps.name: Data Merge
apps.shortDescription: Deep-merges structured data like JSON, YAML, XML, TOML, and Properties instead of diffing raw text.

apps.name: Full Replacement
apps.shortDescription: Replaces an entire file's contents rather than computing or applying a diff.

apps.name: Fuzzy Patch Matcher
apps.shortDescription: Matches and applies edits using Levenshtein-distance fuzzy line matching for imperfect context.

apps.name: Python Patcher
apps.shortDescription: Whitespace-aware diffing and patching tuned for indentation-sensitive languages like Python and YAML.

apps.name: Thermodynamic Patch Matcher
apps.shortDescription: Aligns and applies patches by finding the lowest-energy line-matching configuration.
